books.descriptionZh: 《喜福会》和《接骨师的女儿》的作者的散文和插图，描绘了通过观鸟寻找内心平静的故事。

books.title: Cher
books.author: Cher
books.description: In the first part of her memoir, the multiple award-winning pop culture icon traces her childhood and forays into the world of entertainment.
books.descriptionZh: 在她的回忆录第一部分中，这位屡获殊荣的流行文化偶像追溯了她的童年以及她涉足娱乐界的经历。

books.title: Framed
books.author: John Grisham and Jim McCloskey
books.authorZh: 约翰·格里沙姆和吉姆·麦克洛斯基
books.description: Our criminal justice system viewed through the struggles of 10 wrongfully convicted people to achieve exoneration.
books.descriptionZh: 通过 10 名被错误定罪的人争取无罪释放的斗争，来审视我们的刑事司法系统。

books.title: Be Ready When the Luck Happens
books.titleZh: 做好准备，迎接好运的到来
books.author: Ina Garten
books.description: A memoir by the cookbook author and Food Network host known as the Barefoot Contessa.
books.descriptionZh: 这位被誉为“赤脚女伯爵”的烹饪书作家兼美食频道主持人撰写的回忆录。

books.title: Melania
books.author: Melania Trump
books.description: The first lady describes her work as a fashion model, marriage to Donald Trump and time in the White House.
books.descriptionZh: 第一夫人讲述了她作为时装模特的工作、与唐纳德·特朗普的婚姻以及在白宫的生活。

books.title: Lethal Prey
books.author: John Sandford
books.description: The 35th book in the Prey series. True-crime bloggers complicate Lucas Davenport and Virgil Flowers’s search for a killer.
books.descriptionZh: 《猎物》系列第35部。犯罪纪实博客让卢卡斯·达文波特和维吉尔·弗劳尔斯追查凶手的行动变得更加复杂。

books.title: Onyx Storm
books.author: Rebecca Yarros
books.description: The third book in the Empyrean series. As enemies gain traction, Violet Sorrengail goes beyond the Aretian wards in search of allies.
books.descriptionZh: 《天界》系列的第三部。随着敌人的步步紧逼，维奥莱特·索伦盖尔不得不突破阿瑞提安结界，寻找盟友。

books.title: Nobody's Fool
books.author: Harlan Coben
books.description: The private investigator Sami Kierce tracks down clues to solve a mystery from his past.
books.descriptionZh: 私家侦探萨米·基尔斯追踪线索，解开他过去的一个谜团。

books.title: Summer in the City
books.author: Alex Aster
books.description: A screenwriter seeking inspiration coincidentally moves next door to the billionaire with whom she hooked up a couple years ago.
books.descriptionZh: 一位编剧为了寻找灵感，偶然搬到了几年前和她有过一段情的亿万富翁的隔壁。

books.title: Abundance
books.author: Ezra Klein and Derek Thompson
books.authorZh: 埃兹拉·克莱因和德里克·汤普森
books.description: A New York Times opinion columnist and a staff writer at The Atlantic evaluate obstacles to American progress.
books.descriptionZh: 《纽约时报》的一位专栏作家和《大西洋月刊》的一位撰稿人评估了美国进步所面临的障碍。

books.title: When the Going Was Good
books.author: Graydon Carter with James Fox
books.authorZh: 格雷顿·卡特与詹姆斯·福克斯
books.description: The co-creator of Spy and former editor of Vanity Fair retraces his storied career.
books.descriptionZh: 《女间谍》的联合创作人、前《名利场》杂志编辑回顾了他传奇的职业生涯。

books.title: Don't Let Him in
books.author: Lisa Jewell
books.description: A man with dark secrets in his past may cause trouble for three women who did not heed the warning about him.
books.descriptionZh: 一个有着黑暗过往的男人可能会给三个没有听从警告的女人带来麻烦。

books.title: A Mother's Love
books.author: Danielle Steel
books.description: After her handbag is stolen during a trip to Paris, a best-selling author with a traumatic past determines not to be a victim.
books.descriptionZh: 一位有着创伤过往的畅销书作家在巴黎旅行期间手提包被盗后，决心不再做受害者。

books.title: Atmosphere
books.author: Taylor Jenkins Reid
books.description: In the summer of 1980, Joan Goodwin begins training with a group of candidates for NASA’s space shuttle program.
books.descriptionZh: 1980 年夏天，琼·古德温开始与一群美国宇航局航天飞机计划的候选人一起接受训练。

books.title: One Golden Summer
books.author: Carley Fortune
books.description: A photographer returns to a place where she spent a summer as a teenager and runs into the guy she had a crush on back then.
books.descriptionZh: 一位摄影师回到她青少年时期度过夏天的地方，偶遇了她当时暗恋的男生。

books.title: Severed Heart
books.author: Kate Stewart
books.description: The second book in the Ravenhood Legacy series. Tyler gets his friend’s aunt to help him on his quest to become a man before his time.
books.descriptionZh: 《渡鸦家族传奇》系列的第二部。泰勒请求朋友的姑姑帮助他提前成为真正的男人。

books.title: Behind the Badge
books.author: Johnny Joey Jones
books.description: The Fox News military analyst extols the first responders among his friends and family.
books.descriptionZh: 这位福克斯新闻军事分析员盛赞他的朋友和家人中的急救人员。

books.title: Not My Type
books.author: E. Jean Carroll
books.description: The journalist shares moments from her life and the two trials in which she accused President Trump of sexual assault and defamation.
books.descriptionZh: 这位记者分享了她生活中的一些片段，以及她指控特朗普总统性侵犯和诽谤的两起审判过程。

books.title: Mark Twain
books.author: Ron Chernow
books.description: The Pulitzer Prize-winning biographer portrays the life and career of the literary celebrity and political pundit.
books.descriptionZh: 这位荣获普利策奖的传记作家描绘了这位文学名人和政治评论员的生活和事业。

books.title: Alchemised
books.author: SenLinYu
books.description: After the war, an imprisoned alchemist is sent to a necromancer to recover her lost memories.
books.descriptionZh: 战后，一名被囚禁的炼金术士被送往一位死灵法师处，以恢复她失去的记忆。

books.title: The Primal of Blood and Bone
books.author: Jennifer L. Armentrout
books.description: The sixth book in the Blood and Ash series. The Blood Crown has fallen and the Primal of Death must be stopped.
books.descriptionZh: 《血与灰》系列第六部。血冠陨落，死亡之神必须被阻止。

books.title: The Secret of Secrets
books.author: Dan Brown
books.description: As he searches for the missing noetic scientist he has been seeing, Robert Langdon discovers something regarding a secret project.
books.descriptionZh: 在寻找失踪的、他一直与之见面的精神科学家的过程中，罗伯特·兰登发现了一些与秘密项目有关的事情。

books.title: Circle of Days
books.author: Ken Follett
books.description: A priestess envisions a great stone circle put together by divided tribes, but drought and violence may impede its creation.
books.descriptionZh: 一位女祭司设想由分裂的部落共同建造一个巨大的石圈，但干旱和暴力可能会阻碍它的建成。

books.title: Tourist Season
books.author: Brynne Weaver
books.description: When a true crime investigator comes to Cape Carnage in search of a serial killer, a local gardener and a handsome tourist pause their deadly ways.
books.descriptionZh: 当一名真正的犯罪调查员来到卡纳奇角寻找连环杀手时，一位当地园丁和一位英俊的游客暂停了他们致命的犯罪活动。

books.title: 107 Days
books.author: Kamala Harris
books.description: The former vice president recounts her abbreviated campaign to become president in 2024.
books.descriptionZh: 这位前副总统回顾了她短暂的2024年总统竞选之旅。

books.title: Poems & Prayers
books.author: Matthew McConaughey
books.description: The actor and author of “Greenlights” explores elements of belief and reason that make up our lives.
books.descriptionZh: 《绿灯》的作者兼演员探讨了构成我们生活的信仰和理性要素。

books.title: Awake
books.author: Jen Hatmaker
books.description: The host of the "For the Love" podcast describes major shifts in her life after her marriage of 26 years ended.
books.descriptionZh: “为了爱”播客的主持人讲述了她结束26年婚姻后，生活中发生的重大变化。

books.title: Confronting Evil
books.author: Bill O'Reilly and Josh Hammer
books.authorZh: 比尔·奥雷利和乔什·哈默
books.description: O'Reilly and Hammer profile some of history's nefarious characters.
books.descriptionZh: 奥莱利和哈默描绘了历史上一些臭名昭著的人物。

books.title: Softly, as I Leave You
books.author: Priscilla Beaulieu Presley with Mary Jane Ross
books.authorZh: 普里西拉·博利厄·普雷斯利与玛丽·简·罗斯
books.description: Presley recounts her tribulations and search for identity after spending a decade with Elvis.
books.descriptionZh: 普雷斯利讲述了她与猫王共度十年后所经历的磨难以及寻找自我认同的故事。

books.title: Theo of Golden
books.author: Allen Levi
books.description: A man travels to a small Southern town, where he purchases pencil drawings of local residents and exchanges them for stories.
books.descriptionZh: 一个男人来到南方的一个小镇，在那里他购买当地居民的铅笔画，并用这些画作换取他们的故事。

books.title: Project Hail Mary
books.author: Andy Weir
books.description: Ryland Grace awakes from a long sleep alone and far from home, and the fate of humanity rests on his shoulders; the basis of the movie.
books.descriptionZh: 莱兰·格雷斯从长眠中醒来，独自一人远离家乡，人类的命运就掌握在他手中；这就是这部电影的剧情。

books.title: The Deal
books.author: Elle Kennedy
books.description: Hannah Wells makes a deal with the captain of the college hockey team in exchange for tutoring him that may complicate their relationship.
books.descriptionZh: 汉娜·威尔斯与大学冰球队队长达成协议，以辅导他为交换条件，这可能会使他们的关系变得复杂。

books.title: The Divorce
books.author: Freida McFadden
books.description: After her husband ends their marriage and she turns her attention to his new girlfriend, Naomi suspects she might be in danger.
books.descriptionZh: 丈夫提出离婚后，娜奥米将注意力转移到丈夫的新女友身上，娜奥米怀疑自己可能身处险境。

books.title: A Marriage at Sea
books.author: Sophie Elmhirst
books.description: In 1972, an incident with a breaching whale turns a couple’s dream of sailing on a boat into a monthslong struggle for survival on a raft.
books.descriptionZh: 1972 年，一头跃出水面的鲸鱼让一对夫妇乘船出海的梦想变成了在木筏上长达数月的生存斗争。

books.title: Cool Machine
books.author: Colson Whitehead
books.description: In the third book in the Harlem trilogy, 1980s crime and capitalism affect Ray Carney and the people around him.
books.descriptionZh: 在哈莱姆三部曲的第三部中，20 世纪 80 年代的犯罪和资本主义影响了雷·卡尼和他周围的人。

books.title: A Forsaken Prophecy
books.author: Stacey McEwan
books.description: The second book in the Artisan trilogy. Nina and Patrick search for resources that may alter the course of the war.
books.descriptionZh: 《工匠三部曲》第二部。妮娜和帕特里克寻找可能改变战争走向的资源。

books.title: Mad Mabel
books.author: Sally Hepworth
books.description: An elderly woman who was once Australia’s youngest convicted murderer tries to keep her previous life hidden.
books.descriptionZh: 一位曾是澳大利亚最年轻的杀人犯的老妇人试图隐藏她过去的罪行。

books.title: This Is the Plan
books.author: Ben Wikler
books.description: The former chair of the Democratic Party of Wisconsin shares his perspectives on what it takes to win elections.
books.descriptionZh: 威斯康星州民主党前主席分享了他对赢得选举所需条件的看法。

books.title: Dogs, Boys, and Other Things I've Cried About
books.titleZh: 狗、男孩，以及其他我曾为之哭泣的事
books.author: Isabel Klee
books.description: Klee helps foster dogs overcome challenges while she faces her own complications.
books.descriptionZh: Klee在面临自身困境的同时，也帮助寄养犬克服各种挑战。
